title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Peppers
subtitle: Baked pepper halves filled with herbed ricotta
excerpt: Red peppers halved and filled with a creamy mixture of ricotta, wilted spinach, parmesan, and egg, then baked until set and lightly golden. They work as a main with a green salad or as a side alongside roast chicken.
sourceNotes: Based on the Italian tradition of stuffed baked vegetables, common across central and southern Italy.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Stuff the peppers up to 4 hours ahead, cover, and refrigerate. Bake from cold, adding 5 minutes.

content.text: Squeeze as much water out of the wilted spinach as possible before mixing with the ricotta. Wet spinach will make the filling loose and watery.

items.prepNote: wilted in a pan and squeezed very dry

content.text: Preheat the oven to 190C. Arrange the pepper halves cut-side up on a baking tray. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes until just starting to soften.
While the peppers roast, wilt the spinach in a dry frying pan over a high heat for 2 minutes. Tip into a sieve and press out as much liquid as possible with the back of a spoon. Roughly chop.
In a bowl, mix together the ricotta, half the parmesan, the garlic, nutmeg, beaten egg, and chopped spinach. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into the par-roasted pepper halves. Scatter the remaining parmesan over the top.
Return to the oven and bake for 20 minutes until the filling is set and lightly golden on top.

items.fix: Squeeze spinach harder and pat with kitchen paper before mixing.

items.cause: Pre-roasted for too long before filling
items.fix: Reduce the initial roast to 10 minutes.
